title_en: Spring 2027 Overseas Study Scholarship: Selection Plan and Application
summary: Eligible undergraduates selected for a Spring 2027 exchange student program, with a Fall 2026 student financial aid income bracket of 8 or below and a previous-semester GPA of 2.4 or higher, may apply for the Spring 2027 Overseas Study Scholarship. Applications must be submitted online through mySNU (마이스누) between 1 December 2026 and 18:00 on 8 December 2026.
applies_to: Undergraduate students who meet all of the following: (1) a Fall 2026 (2026학년도 2학기) student financial aid income bracket of 8 or below, as calculated by the Korea Student Aid Foundation (a bracket calculated for the National Scholarship, student loans, National Work Scholarship or similar is accepted); (2) a GPA of 2.4 or higher in the previous semester; and (3) selection for a Spring 2027 exchange student program run by the Office of International Affairs (국제처) or by the university's own exchange program. Application is voluntary; eligible students who wish to be considered must apply.

dates.what: Online application period for the Spring 2027 Overseas Study Scholarship (closes at 18:00 on the last day)

conditions: Approximately 30 students will be selected; this number may change depending on the budget.
Applicants must have a Fall 2026 student financial aid income bracket of 8 or below.
Any income bracket calculated by the Korea Student Aid Foundation is accepted, including those calculated for the National Scholarship, student loans or the National Work Scholarship.
Applicants must have a GPA of 2.4 or higher in the previous semester.
Applicants must already be selected for a Spring 2027 exchange student program of the Office of International Affairs or the university's own exchange program.
Applications are approved in bulk by the Scholarship and Welfare Division (장학복지과).
steps: Confirm that you meet all eligibility requirements: undergraduate status, Fall 2026 income bracket of 8 or below, previous-semester GPA of 2.4 or higher, and selection for a Spring 2027 exchange student program.
Apply online through mySNU (마이스누) between 1 December 2026 and 18:00 on 8 December 2026 (the notice does not give a menu path).
Wait for the Scholarship and Welfare Division (장학복지과) to process approval of applications in bulk.
translation:
Spring 2027 Overseas Study Scholarship Selection Plan

The selection plan for the Spring 2027 (2027학년도 1학기) Overseas Study Scholarship (해외수학장학생) is announced as follows. Eligible students are asked to apply.

A. Number of recipients: approximately 30 (may change depending on the budget)

B. Eligibility: Undergraduate students with a Fall 2026 (2026학년도 2학기) student financial aid income bracket* of 8 or below (with a previous-semester GPA of 2.4 or higher) who have been selected for a Spring 2027 exchange student program of the Office of International Affairs (국제처) or the university's own exchange program.
* Any student financial aid income bracket calculated by the Korea Student Aid Foundation, including those for the National Scholarship, student loans and the National Work Scholarship, is accepted.

C. Application period: Tuesday 1 December 2026 to Tuesday 8 December 2026, 18:00

D. How to apply: Apply online through mySNU (마이스누). (The Scholarship and Welfare Division (장학복지과) will process approvals in bulk.)
